# scaas-sdk plan T20b: the sync C++ surface (spec §16.1 (a′)), generated by uniffi-bindgen-cpp into generated/, built over the
# reference library with feature `sync-api` (../lib.sh sync-api: ffi/target/lib-sync-api/). The smoke test: the keystore and
# vault rows, a C++ store and authenticator, a panic as Internal, a C++ exception as Unexpected (bash ../../runs gate `bind-cpp`:
# cmake -B build && cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(scaas_sdk_cpp CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
set(LIB ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../ffi/target/lib-sync-api)
set(ROWS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/rows.tsv)
execute_process(
  COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -I ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../rows.py
          ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../smartcontracts/vectors/keystore/keystore.json ${ROWS}
  COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)
file(GLOB GENERATED ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/*.cpp)
add_executable(smoke smoke.cpp ${GENERATED})
target_include_directories(smoke PRIVATE generated)
target_link_libraries(smoke PRIVATE ${LIB}/libscaas_sdk_ffi.so)
set_target_properties(smoke PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH ${LIB})
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME smoke COMMAND smoke ${ROWS})
